current_activity: The 5th Fallschirmjäger Division is listed under the LXXX Corps (First Army)
notes: Event date: Nafziger Collection 944GIAB, 16 September 1944: "LXXX Corps: Panzer Lehr Division: kampfgruppe 5th Fallschirmjäger Division:"; CMH Siegfried Line ch. 3 p. 42: "the LXXX Corps had only one unit in this sector bearing a division label. This was the 5th Parachute Division, which, like some of General Keppler's units, had little left except a name". Event definition: the 5th Fallschirmjäger Division under the LXXX Corps on 16 September; CMH p. 42 has it in the corps sector when the First Army reported on 13 September; this row ends the First Parachute Army relation CR0630 (Schramm p. 366: given to the First Parachute Army on 4 September, one row, C0895) on the day before, as an inferred value, because the Nafziger file and the CMH put the division under the LXXX Corps on 16 September. Event support: the Nafziger file and the CMH agree (two families). Location: Wallendorf (PL0412), with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the Wallendorf sector point of the corps. Location support: CMH p. 42 places the division in the corps sector that the V Corps attacked. Commander: unknown.

source_locator: R640: p. 213, 215-216; R643: listing under the LXXXV Corps heading
current_activity: The 5th Fallschirmjäger Division crosses the Our at Roth and wipes out the outpost at Vianden
notes: Event date: CMH Ardennes ch. 9 p. 215: "the 15th Parachute Regiment was intended to cross the Our at Roth (named as the main divisional bridge site), seize the high ground near Vianden"; p. 216: "the 5th Parachute Division engineers wiped out the 2d Battalion outpost in the château ruins at Vianden"; Nafziger 944GLAA (15 December 1944): "5th Parachute Division: Oberst L. Heilmann". Event definition: the opening of the offensive on 16 December. Event support: two source families: CMH and Nafziger. Location: Vianden with a precision of 5 km, the town of the outpost; Roth, the bridge site, could not be geocoded separately. Location approximate: a town point. Location support: CMH names Roth and Vianden. Commander: Oberst Ludwig Heilmann. Opponents: US VIII Corps (109th Infantry, 110th Infantry).

location_qualifier: south-eastern fringe of the Bastogne salient
current_activity: 5th Parachute Division is surprised by the US 90th Division on the south-east fringe of the Bastogne salient
notes: Event date: CMH The Last Offensive ch. 2 p. 40: "On 9 January a newly arrived but veteran 90th Infantry Division (Maj. Gen. James A. Van Fleet) attacked to the northeast through positions of the 26th Division (Maj. Gen. Willard S. Paul) along the southeastern fringe of the German salient"; "the 90th Division on the first day took the enemy's 5th Parachute Division by surprise". Event definition: the attack of 9 January. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Bastogne with a precision of 25 km, the salient whose south-eastern fringe was attacked; no place is named for the division. Location approximate: the town of Bastogne for the salient fringe. Location support: CMH names the south-eastern fringe of the salient. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US 90th Infantry Division. Context: CMH ch. 2 p. 40 says the Germans began to retire from the salient on the night of 10 January; p. 36 names the 5th Parachute Division among the units that had fought here since before Christmas. The pages name no corps or army for the division.
